basic_info.description: Fantastic opportunity in the Outer Parkside! 2728 Vicente is a classic 2BR / 1BA mid-century home with a 1-car garage, bonus room, and a deep 25' x 100' lot offering endless upside. The main level features two bedrooms, a full bath, and a bright living room with parquet floors. A spacious eat-in kitchen and dining nook offer great natural light and a functional layout. Downstairs includes a bonus room identified as a workshop on the 3R report, laundry, storage, and direct access to the expansive, terraced backyard.    Tenant-occupied @ $2,300/month (2 adults, 3 children) and will be delivered occupied. Longtime tenants in place. Ideal for investors, contractors, or buyers looking to create value over time. Potential for expansion or ADU (buyer to verify).    Needs updating but has great bones, a large lot (25'x100') and plenty of space to reimagine your dream home or long-term investment. Sold as-is. Shown by appointment onlyplease do not disturb occupants.  Situated near Ocean Beach, the SF Zoo, Stern Grove, Taraval shops, MUNI, and easy freeway access.
